name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-06-08, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
